item.tib: mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig sde lnga las rgyud srung mkha' 'gro'i srug byang
item.coloph: ces pa 'di yang dus mtha'i kho bo 'gru btsun tshe dbang grags pa'am gsang mtshan bde chen gling pas mdo smad lung grags kyi sa gnas brag dkar yang rtse shel brag rin chen spungs pa'i mdun gter sgrom shel gyi pha wang nas chu glang lo'i zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu drug nyi ma rtse shar la ye shes mkha' 'gro'i grogs dang bcas te dngos grub rnyed/ phyis lo gcig gi gsang rgya yol nas lung zin slob mas bskul nas brda yig bod yig tu thar bde smin grol gling du phab nas yi ge pa ni rmong (rmongs) blun drung mu wer zhi'i (zhis) sor rtser bskur nas gter dpe dngos yin pas phyi rabs 'dri ('bri) mkhan rnams kyi (kyis) bcos bslad med par gyis dang byin rlabs myur bar 'byung zhing / bcos bslad rang 'dod kyi 'dri (kyis 'bri) bsnan byas na gter srung ye shes mkha' 'gro re ti mo'i (mos) bka' chad myur du 'byung bar nges pas yid tan byos//
